art_instructions: High-angle wide view of a cozy attic-style bedroom with a sloped ceiling, exposed wooden beams, and creamy walls lit by warm amber lamplight; a small rounded window shows a slim moon and stars. Along the far wall, four child-sized wooden beds with forest-green blankets are arranged left to right; a tiny wooden nightstand between the middle two holds a glowing acorn lantern and a small stack of picture books. At the leftmost bed, Panda is halfway climbing under the blanket, one knee on the mattress and one foot on a small stool, eyes sleepy with a gentle yawn; a little acorn pouch rests at the footboard. In the second bed, Koala kneels on the mattress pulling the blanket up to her chest, calm and drowsy, with her leaf-green scarf neatly draped over the bedpost. At the third bed, Dinosaur swings his legs onto the mattress, tail peeking from the blanket, smiling softly; his small red backpack sits on the floor beside the bed. In the rightmost bed, Owl is tucking herself under the green blanket, round amber eyes still bright; her green scarf hangs from the bedpost and her tiny satchel rests on the nightstand. A low shelf of stuffed animals and trinkets runs along the right wall, and a soft oval rug lies in front of the beds. Warm lantern light fills the room while a hint of cool moonlight edges the scene, showing all four animals getting into their beds for the night.
